title: Kneaded Crunchy Dutch Potato Casserole
description: A rich and crunchy Dutch dish featuring Italian seasoning, made diabetic-friendly with careful ingredient selection, and cooked in a banana leaf vessel.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine sliced potatoes, italian seasoning, salt, and black pepper, and knead until they are well coated.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until it is translucent.
Add the coated potatoes to the skillet and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked potatoes, grated cheese, and sauteed onion, and mix well.
Lay a banana leaf flat on a work surface and place one quarter of the potato mixture in the center of the leaf.
Fold the banana leaf over the filling to form a square package, and repeat with the remaining ingredients.
Place the packages in a baking dish and bake for 30 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender and the cheese is melted and golden brown.
